Site visibility and Coming soon mode, which controls who can visit the site while it is prepared for launch (WC-S-0009, WC-S-0891), on by default for new shops (WC-S-5421), and the Launch your store task and resource (WC-S-0423, WC-S-0248). Not landed in CM-ACC-007: see its note and U-069.

WooPayments' cardholder data security: WooPayments is PCI DSS compliant as a Level 1 service provider (WC-S-0550) and Automattic acknowledges responsibility for the cardholder data it handles for WooPayments users (WC-S-0479); the payment fields are served from the payment partner's PCI DSS-validated environment (WC-S-0552). WooPayments is Automattic's service, not the WooCommerce software (reading).

The merchant's own PCI scope: the core plugin is not PCI certified, as it handles no cardholder data (WC-S-5304), and PCI DSS compliance is ultimately the store owner's (WC-S-5303). WooCommerce splits it from WC-C-018; Shopify's SH-C-184 holds both (M-062's granularity note), so both land in CM-TRU-018 rather than in two children.

Joined on role, a reading: the Store guidelines list what may not be sold through the e-commerce services on a WordPress.com site (WC-S-0951) and bind e-commerce there to WordPress.com's User Guidelines (WC-S-0952), the platform company's rules on what merchants may do, as Shopify's Acceptable Use Policy (SH-S-0166) and Salla's violations (SA-S-0115). They are WordPress.com's, Automattic's, scoped to WordPress.com sites, not the WooCommerce software's. No report of violations or action on them is held for WooCommerce.

Automattic companies as controllers of personal information for Woo services: generally the company contracting with the user (WC-S-0494), Automattic Inc. for some processing of WooCommerce, Inc.'s services, and Automattic Inc. with WooCommerce, Inc. as joint controllers for WooCommerce Ireland Ltd.'s (WC-S-0497, WC-S-0498).

Automattic's Terms 8.j: Automattic is not involved in the merchant's transactions, and the merchant is solely responsible for its ecommerce activities (WC-S-0466): consent, receipts, verifying customers' identities (WC-S-0468), complaints, disputes, refunds and fines (WC-S-0469).
